ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show fee to the rider's original payment method; no driver fault finding (GPS shows a 90-second gap after arrival), but log the weak-contact/early-cancel pattern for driver coaching.
ruling.reasoning:
Screening: the complaint, driver statement and brief chat contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; safety_concern = none.

Elements (NS-0/NS-1): driver cancelled under reason "rider_no_show", so NS-1 governs.
(i) Arrival — driver_arrival_time 14:03:30 and app event "driver_arrived" at 14:03:30. The final telemetry point before arrival (14:03:00) is on Temasek Boulevard at 1.292376/103.857183, ~150 m from the pickup point (1.2955/103.8585) — within the 200 m radius. Met.
(ii) Free wait — booked 14:05; arrival 14:03:30. Counted from the later of the two (14:05:00), five minutes elapse at 14:10:00. The driver cancelled at 14:09:00, i.e. 4 minutes after the scheduled pickup time and 5.5 minutes after arrival — short of the 5-minute free wait. Not met.
(iii) Contact — one in-app message at 14:04:00 (before the segment/at the point) and one unanswered in-app call at 14:05:00. Met.
(iv) Continuous presence — telemetry runs 14:04:00–14:09:00 continuously at ~1–2 km/h at the pickup, but there is a 90-second sampling hole between arrival (14:03:30) and 14:04:00; presence in that interval is unproven. This alone would be an evidence gap, not a ground of decision.

Because condition (ii) fails, the $5.00 fee is voided under NS-2 and refunded in full. This is not a case where the driver marked arrival while away from the pickup, so no account flag under NS-2/NS-1; the rider's own statement ("cancelled 4 minutes after") and the driver's statement ("more than 6 minutes") both give way to the system records, which show 5.5 minutes from arrival and 4 minutes from the scheduled time. Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel) confirms the fee turns on the strict NS-1 conditions. Amount within TH-1/TH-2 ($5.00 fixed, system final).

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived at pickup (I'm Here / auto-confirm, GPS within 200 m)
element_findings.reason: Arrival event at 14:03:30 is corroborated by the 14:03:00 telemetry point on Temasek Boulevard at 1.292376/103.857183, ~150 m from the pickup point 1.2955/103.8585 (within the 200 m radius).

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancellation (later of scheduled time and arrival)
element_findings.reason: Later of scheduled pickup 14:05:00 and arrival 14:03:30 is 14:05:00; five minutes run to 14:10:00. Cancellation at 14:09:00 is 4 minutes after 14:05:00 and 5.5 minutes after arrival — under the free wait.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) before cancelling, ≥1 in-app message and ≥1 in-app call
element_findings.reason: Two in-app messages to the rider (14:04:00, 14:08:50) and one in-app call at 14:05:00, though unanswered.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at the pickup point throughout the wait
element_findings.reason: Telemetry from 14:04:00 to 14:09:00 is stationary at the pickup, but a 90-second gap between arrival (14:03:30) and the next sample (14:04:00) leaves the interval unproven; the wasted wait is anyway short of the threshold, so this gap does not change the outcome.

The recorded reason is rider_no_show and the driver's messages/statement are consistent with that account, so NS-1 (not NS-3) is the governing clause; the fee nevertheless fails the free-wait condition.

rejected_claims.reason: System records show arrival 14:03:30 and cancellation 14:09:00 — 5.5 minutes from arrival but only 4 minutes from the scheduled 14:05:00 pickup; the 5-minute free wait counted from the later of the two had not elapsed.
Consistent with the record (arrival 14:03:30) but immaterial: the free wait runs from 14:05:00, so early arrival does not extend it before the cancelled trip.

ruling.evidence_gap: GPS telemetry thinned to every 6th sample leaves a 90-second hole between the 14:03:30 arrival event and the 14:04:00 sample, so continuous presence at the pickup during the first 90 seconds after arrival cannot be verified (NS-1(iv)). The provided samples do establish the 14:04:00–14:09:00 presence and the sub-5-minute wait, which decide the case.
